name: Frontend Design
description: Design distinctive frontend interfaces outside an existing brand system, with deliberate typography, color, motion and composition. Adapted from Anthropic's design guidance for local work in Wevir.
examples: Build a responsive landing page for a small ceramics studio with no existing brand. Use local assets and preview it locally.
Create a standalone HTML portfolio for a documentary photographer, with a bold visual direction and no remote fonts or images.
Design a responsive concert listing for a community jazz venue with no existing design system. Keep all assets local.

zh-CN.name: 前端设计
zh-CN.description: 为尚无既定品牌规范的前端界面确定鲜明的设计方向，细化字体、配色、动效与空间构图。基于 Anthropic 的设计指导，适配 Wevir 本地开发与预览。
examples: 为一家尚无品牌规范的小型陶艺工作室做响应式首页，使用本地素材并在本地预览。
为纪实摄影师制作独立 HTML 作品集，确定鲜明的视觉方向，不使用远程字体或图片。
为尚无设计系统的社区爵士乐场地设计响应式演出列表，所有素材保存在本地。
